title: Query length bounded by the computation length
statement: For an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, an oracle language $O$, an input word $x$, and a finite sequence $w$ of nondeterministic choice bits, the query word on the final query tape after running $N$ with $O$ from its initial configuration on $x$ has length at most $|w|$.
